name: Site Promotion Directory
conditions: Regular free links: ~4-6 month review (700+ submissions/day backlog); listing not guaranteed
Regular free links WITH reciprocal link on your home/index page: ~1-2 months review
Featured links $8.96: guaranteed approval, reviewed in 24-48 hours (non-refundable review fee)
requirements: Quality sites only; worldwide business sites incl. hosting/VPS explicitly welcome
Required form fields: Title, URL, Your Name, Your Email, Category
Optional: Description (has a character limit), META keywords (comma-separated), META description
Editors may move your site to a more appropriate category
preparation: Title, URL, short description, META keywords, META description, your name and email
Choose the correct leaf category from a very large tree (13 top categories, ~687 subcategories)
If going the reciprocal route: put their link on your home/index page first
Decide free vs $8.96 featured (guaranteed 1-2 day approval)
workflow: Fill Title, URL, Description, META keywords/description, name, email
Pick the most specific suitable category in the huge category selector
Choose link type: regular (free, 4-6 mo), reciprocal (free, ~2 mo), or featured ($8.96, 1-2 days)
watchFor: Classic phpLD-style directory with a massive category dropdown - selecting a wrong/too-broad category invites moves or rejection
Free review can take 4-6 months; the stats bar showed ~198k pending links vs ~7k active - approval odds on free are low
Featured fee is a non-refundable 'review fee' even though approval is advertised as guaranteed
Reciprocal link must sit on your home/index page to qualify for the faster free queue
countsAsLive: The site appears as an active link under its chosen category (and in Latest Links) on sitepromotiondirectory.com.
unknowns: Whether account registration is needed (login/register links exist on the site)
